arxiv-1801-08937.title: Iterative map-making with two-level preconditioning for polarized Cosmic Microwave Background data sets
arxiv-1801-08937.creator: Giuseppe Puglisi, Davide Poletti, Giulio Fabbian, Carlo Baccigalupi, Luca Heltai, Radek Stompor
arxiv-1801-08937.description: Abstract Context. An estimation of the sky signal from streams of Time Ordered Data (TOD) acquired by the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) experiments is one of the most important steps in the context of CMB data analysis referred to as the map-making problem.

arxiv-2107-00715.title: NDN4IVC: A Framework for Simulating and Testing of Applications in Vehicular Named Data Networking
arxiv-2107-00715.creator: Guilherme B. Araujo, Maycon L. M. Peixoto, Leobino N. Sampaio, guilherme.araujo@ufrb.edu.br, {maycon.leone, leobino}@ufba.br
arxiv-2107-00715.description: Abstract This paper presents a customized framework (NDN4IVC) for simulating and testing intelligent transportation systems and applications in vehicular named-data networking (V-NDN). The project uses two popular simulators in the literature for VANET simulation, a network simulator based on discrete events (Ns-3), with ndnSIM module installed, and Sumo, a simulator for urban mobility.

arxiv-2208-14255.title: Empirical and Full Bayes estimation of the type of a Pitman-Yor process
arxiv-2208-14255.creator: S.E.M.P. Franssen, A.W. van der Vaart
arxiv-2208-14255.description: Abstract The Pitman-Yor process is a random discrete probability distribution of which the atoms can be used to model the relative abundance of species. The process is indexed by a type parameter σ \sigma , which controls the number of different species in a finite sample from a realization of the distribution.

arxiv-2404-16457.title: Towards Precise Observations of Neural Model Robustness in Classification Conference: 46th International Conference on Software Engineering; April 2024; Lisbon, Portugal Conference: 2024 IEEE/ACM 46th International Conference on Software Engineering: Companion Proceedings; April 14–20, 2024; Lisbon,
arxiv-2404-16457.creator: Wenchuan Mu, Kwan Hui Lim
arxiv-2404-16457.description: Abstract . In deep learning applications, robustness measures the ability of neural models that handle slight changes in input data, which could lead to potential safety hazards, especially in safety-critical applications. Pre-deployment assessment of model robustness is essential, but existing methods often suffer from either high costs or imprecise results.

arxiv-2411-05194.title: Interactive Dialogue Agents via Reinforcement Learning on Hindsight Regenerations
arxiv-2411-05194.creator: Joey Hong, Jessica Lin, Anca Dragan, Sergey Levine
arxiv-2411-05194.description: Abstract Recent progress on large language models (LLMs) has enabled dialogue agents to generate highly naturalistic and plausible text. However, current LLM language generation focuses on responding accurately to questions and requests with a single effective response. In reality, many real dialogues are interactive , meaning an agent’s utterances will influence their conversational partner, elicit information, or change their opinion.

arxiv-2602-24265.description: Abstract . User simulators are essential for evaluating search systems, but they primarily copy user actions without understanding the underlying thought process. This gap exists since large-scale interaction logs record what users do, but not what they might be thinking or feeling, such as confusion or satisfaction.

pmc-10493876.title: Natural killer cell T-cell lymphoma (nasal type), a rare and aggressive type of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma: Case report
pmc-10493876.creator: Devraj Kandel, Shishan Dhakal, Sushila Thapa, Prakash Dhakal, Surendra Rayamajhi, Jagat Baniya
pmc-10493876.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In the sinonasal tract, diffuse large B-cell lymphomas are the predominant type non-Hodgkin's lymphoma while natural killer (NK) cell T-cell lymphoma, the nasal type, constitute only 3%-12% of NHLs in this region and is the more aggressive subtype. NK cell T-cell lymphoma mostly occurs in male at the median age of 50 years and has got a poor prognosis with a 3-years overall survival (OS) of 46.3% and a 5-years OS of 42%.

pmc-11507017.title: The Maize Gene ZmGLYI-8 Confers Salt and Drought Tolerance in Transgenic Arabidopsis Plants
pmc-11507017.creator: Ting Yu, Wei Dong, Xinwei Hou, Aiqing Sun, Xinzheng Li, Shaowei Yu, Jiedao Zhang
pmc-11507017.description: Methylglyoxal (MG), a highly reactive and cytotoxic α-oxoaldehyde compound, can over-accumulate under abiotic stress, consequently injuring plants or even causing death. Glyoxalase I (GLYI), the first enzyme of the glyoxalase pathway, plays multiple roles in the detoxification of MG and in abiotic stress responses. However, the GLY1 gene in maize has been little studied in response to abiotic stress.

pmc-11532480.title: Polaritons light up future displays
pmc-11532480.creator: Andreas Mischok
pmc-11532480.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Exciton-polaritons have long been a focus point of fundamental research towards polariton lasing, chemistry, and quantum optics. Recent developments now show their extraordinary potential for efficient and bright displays with ultimate color purity.Subject terms: Organic LEDs, Polaritons

Organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) have revolutionized the display industry over the past 25 years and today, OLED displays can be found in a majority of high-end smartphones, as well as TVs, smartwatches, and many more consumer devices.

pmc-11587189.title: Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy Sensitivity in Patients With Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma Using CT-Based Radiomics Combined With Clinical Features
pmc-11587189.creator: Xindi Li, Jigang Dong, Baosheng Li, Ouyang Aimei, Yahong Sun, Xia Wu, Wenjuan Liu, Ruobing Li, Zhongyuan Li, Yu Yang
pmc-11587189.description: Background: For patients with resectable locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), the current standard treatment is neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) plus radical surgery. Objective: This study aimed to establish a predictive model, based on computed tomography (CT) radiomics features and clinical parameters, to predict sensitivity to nCRT in patients with ESCC pre-treatment.

pmc-12730670.title: Effects of Bamboo Expansion on Soil Enzyme Activity and Its Stoichiometric Ratios in Karst Broad-Leaved Forests
pmc-12730670.creator: Long Tong, Qingping Zeng, Lijie Chen, Xiaoying Zeng, Ling Shen, Fengling Gan, Minglan Liang, Lixia Chen, Xiaoyan Zhang, Lianghua Qi
pmc-12730670.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigated the effects of different expansion ratios of bamboo within broad-leaved forest (MRB) and soil depths on soil microbial resource limitation in a field experiment conducted in a karst region. The results demonstrated that soil enzyme activity and stoichiometric ratios are indirectly influenced by soil bulk density and root characteristics.

pmc-12779996.title: Plasma-based brain age as a potential biomarker for cognitive health and risk of brain-related disorders
pmc-12779996.creator: Biqi Wang, Huitong Ding, Derek Qi, Mayra S. Tisminetzky, Joanne M. Murabito, Honghuang Lin
pmc-12779996.description: BackgroundUnderstanding brain aging is essential for identifying early markers of cognitive decline. This study aimed to develop plasma-based biomarkers of brain aging and examine their associations with cognitive function.MethodsWe used data from 53,005 UK Biobank participants (2006–2010) with available Olink proteomics data (mean age 57 ± 8 years, 54% women).

pmc-13195841.title: Function evaluation of intelligent interaction voice prompting system on personal protective equipment removal for medical staff
pmc-13195841.creator: Sha Yang, Min-Rui Li, Hui-Lan Zhang, Jin-Jun Xia, Hong-Xia Luo, Zhong-Lan You, Ting-Ting Li, Jian-Ping You
pmc-13195841.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of an intelligent interaction voice prompting system (IIVPS) for guiding medical staff in the removal of personal protective equipment (PPE).MethodsA total of 152 medical staff members were enrolled via convenience sampling. Using a one-group pretest-posttest design, system effectiveness was evaluated by comparing pre- and post-intervention PPE removal accuracy, psychological stress, and operational fatigue, with nonparametric tests for statistical analyses.

pmc-13309882.title: From Real-World Research to Real-World Decisions: Insights from ICHR-26 at Rehman Medical Institute Peshawar
pmc-13309882.creator: Seelay Srak Rehman
pmc-13309882.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fourth International Conference on Health Research (ICHR-26), hosted by Rehman Medical Institute (RMI), brought into focus an important challenge within the current health research landscape, namely the growing disconnect between research production and its practical applicability in real-world decision-making.

pmc-13373216.title: The economically optimal mix and timing of coastal adaptation in Europe to 2150
pmc-13373216.creator: Vanessa Völz, Jochen Hinkel, Daniel Lincke, Lars E Honsel, Robert J Nicholls, Rémi Thiéblemont, Gonéri Le Cozannet, Paul Sayers
pmc-13373216.description: Coastal adaptation to sea level rise involves combining and sequencing adaptation options into adaptation pathways that include adaptation tipping points, which are moments requiring a switch between options, often due to economic limits. While local case studies show costs depend on the economically optimal timing of actions and adaptation tipping points, this remains unexplored on global and continental scales.
